gql-type.name: ReconciliationResult
gql-type.description: One run of a saved reconciliation: which sources it compared, its outcome and how many records were on only one side.

field.name: reconciliationRunResultId
field.description: The run result's id.

field.name: savedRunId
field.description: The saved run (rule set) this run executed.

field.name: savedRunType
field.description: Which kind of saved run it was.

field.name: reconciliationRunId
field.description: The run definition, when the run came from one.

field.name: reconciliationMappingId
field.description: The field mapping the run used, if any.

field.name: ruleSetId
field.description: The rule set the run evaluated.

field.name: file1Name
field.description: The first source's file or extract name.

field.name: file2Name
field.description: The second source's file or extract name.

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: How the run ended, e.g. AUT_STAT_SUCCESS.

field.name: reconciliationType
field.description: The kind of reconciliation the run performed.

field.name: differenceCount
field.description: Records found on only one side (onlyInFile1Count + onlyInFile2Count); value mismatches are not counted.

field.name: onlyInFile1Count
field.description: Records present in the first source and missing from the second.

field.name: onlyInFile2Count
field.description: Records present in the second source and missing from the first.

field.name: createdDate
field.description: When the run result was created.

root-query.name: reconciliationResult
root-query.description: One reconciliation run result by id.

root-query.name: reconciliationResults
root-query.description: Reconciliation run results, newest or oldest first.

root-query.name: auditReport
root-query.description: An audit's report for one morning, from the tenant of the API key.

arg.name: date
arg.description: The morning to describe, YYYY-MM-DD; blank is today in the tenant's time zone.

arg.name: period
arg.description: Which period's run, e.g. 2026-10 while October is extended; blank is the morning's own period.

root-query.name: auditFinding
root-query.description: One finding by id, with its records, evidence, fix and history. Another tenant's finding reads as not found.

root-query.name: findings
root-query.description: The tenant's findings, oldest first by default; each node is the report's finding summary plus its audit, statement, category and period. ageDays is as of today in the tenant's time zone.
root-query.search-keys: audit:eq statement:eq,in category:eq,in state:eq,in period:eq,in firstFound:eq,gt,gte,lt,lte

arg.name: first
arg.description: Return the first n findings, 1 to 100; default 50.

arg.name: after
arg.description: Return findings after this cursor (pageInfo.endCursor). A cursor belongs to its sortKey and reverse.

gql-type.name: AuditReportDocument
gql-type.description: One audit's report for one morning (darpan.audit.report/v1): whether the checks can be trusted, what is open, and every statement by category. The JSON's keyed objects are lists here, each element carrying its key.

field.name: schema
field.description: The document type and major version, always `darpan.audit.report/v1`.

field.name: about
field.description: One sentence saying what this report covers for this tenant.

edge.name: report
edge.description: Which tenant and audit, which morning, which days were read, and which period.

edge.name: health
edge.description: Whether this morning's reads and checks can be trusted.

edge.name: summary
edge.description: Counts across the whole tenant, and the oldest open finding.

edge.name: categories
edge.description: The four categories, each holding its statements and their findings.
edge.lookup-description: One of the four categories by its id; null for an id that is not one of them.
edge.lookup-arg-description: The category id: orders, refundsAndCredits, returns or exchangesAndWarranty.

gql-type.name: AuditReportInfo
gql-type.description: Which tenant and audit, which morning, which days were read, and which period.

field.name: date
field.description: The morning this report describes: the day the scheduled checks ran.

field.name: period
field.description: Which period's run this report describes. Each period of an audit is its own run and report; by default the period `date` falls in.

field.name: running
field.description: Whether this period's audit still runs on `date`: inside the period, or after it while a user's extension covers `date`.

field.name: extendedThru
field.description: The last morning an ended period keeps running. After the period ends, users choose whether it continues; meanwhile the next period's audit starts.

field.name: generatedAt
field.description: When the assembler built this document.

edge.name: tenant
edge.description: Which tenant this report is for.

edge.name: audit
edge.description: Which audit this report is for.

edge.name: window
edge.description: The days the checks read.

gql-type.name: AuditTenant
gql-type.description: The tenant the report belongs to.

field.name: id
field.description: The tenant's id, e.g. `GORJANA`.

field.name: name
field.description: The tenant's display name.

field.name: timeZone
field.description: The IANA zone that every `Date`, `DateTime` and day window in this document uses.

gql-type.name: AuditRef
gql-type.description: An audit: its id within the tenant, name, and the period it reports by.

field.name: id
field.description: The audit's id within the tenant, e.g. `month-close` (`Audit.auditCode`).

field.name: name
field.description: The audit's display name, e.g. "Month close".

field.name: period
field.description: How the audit reports its period: `day`, `month` or `quarter`.

gql-type.name: AuditWindow
gql-type.description: The days the checks read, both ends inclusive, in the tenant's time zone.

field.name: from
field.description: The first day the checks read: the period's first day, so every open finding of the period is examined again each morning (DAR-BE-091).

field.name: thru
field.description: The last day the checks read, inclusive: `date` itself while the period is current ("on the 14th it reconciles 1-14"), the period's last day once it has ended. Records from that morning are usually inside their check's grace age, so they show as `pending`.

gql-type.name: AuditHealth
gql-type.description: Whether this morning's reads and checks can be trusted.

field.name: complete
field.description: True only when every source read was complete and every configured check ran. Statements with no configured check do not make it false; they are listed in `notCovered`.

field.name: summary
field.description: One or two sentences naming any source or check that was not complete, or saying that all were.

field.name: notCovered
field.description: Statements in the catalog with no configured check, for example deferred ones.

edge.name: sources
edge.description: One entry for each system that any check read this morning.

edge.name: checks
edge.description: How many configured checks ran, ran partially, or did not run.

gql-type.name: SourceHealth
gql-type.description: One system's reads this morning, across every check that read it.

field.name: system
field.description: The system: OMS, NetSuite or Shopify.

field.name: read
field.description: The worst status among this system's reads this morning.

field.name: records
field.description: Records read from this system, summed over its reads.

field.name: readAt
field.description: When the last of this system's reads finished.

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the read was partial or failed, in plain words.

field.name: affects
field.description: Statements whose checks read this system and are not `ran` as a result; `[]` when the read was complete.

gql-type.name: CheckCounts
gql-type.description: How the configured checks ran this morning.

field.name: ran
field.description: Configured checks that ran over complete reads.

field.name: partial
field.description: Configured checks that ran over at least one partial or failed read.

field.name: notRun
field.description: Configured checks that did not run this morning.

gql-type.name: AuditSummary
gql-type.description: Counts across the whole tenant, and the oldest open finding.

field.name: open
field.description: Findings in state `open`.

field.name: pending
field.description: Findings in state `pending`, still inside their check's grace age.

field.name: newToday
field.description: Findings first found on `report.date`, whether open or pending.

field.name: fixedToday
field.description: Findings that became `fixed` on `report.date`.

edge.name: oldestOpen
edge.description: The open finding with the earliest `firstFound`.

edge.name: byCategory
edge.description: The same four counts (`open`, `pending`, `newToday`, `fixedToday`) for each category; all four categories are present.

gql-type.name: OldestOpen
gql-type.description: The open finding with the earliest `firstFound`.

field.name: id
field.description: The finding's id.

field.name: statement
field.description: The statement id it breaks.

field.name: firstFound
field.description: The morning it was first found.

field.name: ageDays
field.description: Days since `firstFound`, as of `report.date`.

gql-type.name: CategoryCounts
gql-type.description: The four finding counts for one category.

field.name: category
field.description: The category: orders, refundsAndCredits, returns or exchangesAndWarranty.

field.name: open
field.description: Findings in state `open`.

field.name: pending
field.description: Findings in state `pending`, still inside their check's grace age.

field.name: newToday
field.description: Findings first found on `report.date`, whether open or pending.

field.name: fixedToday
field.description: Findings that became `fixed` on `report.date`.

gql-type.name: FindingCounts
gql-type.description: Findings by state for a category or statement: open, pending, new today and fixed today.

field.name: open
field.description: Findings in state `open`.

field.name: pending
field.description: Findings in state `pending`, still inside their check's grace age.

field.name: newToday
field.description: Findings first found on `report.date`, whether open or pending.

field.name: fixedToday
field.description: Findings that became `fixed` on `report.date`.

gql-type.name: Category
gql-type.description: One of the four categories (orders, refundsAndCredits, returns, exchangesAndWarranty), with its statements.

field.name: id
field.description: The category: orders, refundsAndCredits, returns or exchangesAndWarranty.

field.name: label
field.description: The category's display name, e.g. "Refunds and credits".

edge.name: counts

edge.name: statements
edge.description: Every catalog statement in this category; [] only when the tenant has none in it.

edge.lookup-arg-description: The statement id in the tenant's catalog, e.g. R8.

gql-type.name: Statement
gql-type.description: One thing the tenant needs to be true, its checks this morning, and the findings that break it.

field.name: id
field.description: The statement id, e.g. R4.

field.name: text
field.description: The statement in the tenant's own words.

field.name: weight
field.description: Whether the tenant stated it (`firm`) or it was derived and awaits confirmation (`derived`).

field.name: status
field.description: The worst status among this statement's checks; `notRun` when it has none.

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the statement's checks were partial or did not run.

field.name: findingsOmitted
field.description: How many findings were left out by the 50 cap; `0` when all are shown.

edge.name: counts
edge.description: Ledger counts for this statement; never null, even when its check did not run today.

edge.name: findings

field.description: Records compared in that system.
